title: 2.6 Numbers 1-10
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Recognize, hear, and say the number words one through ten without yet requiring plural object phrases.
grammar_function: Number-word identity only; regular noun plurals are intentionally deferred to 2.8.
prerequisite: 2.3 object recognition; numerals need no English grammar prerequisite.
speaking_outcome: Repeat six sampled number words clearly; remaining number words recur in 2.8 and the unit review.

cards.pedagogy_note: introduces ten; exceptional 10-card Learn is required to avoid testing before introduction
2.4 object-question review; ask the content question before choices
